typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		EffDate as timestamp,
		adp as string,
		producttype1 as string,
		Isin as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource	source(output(
		loadDate as timestamp,
		CLIENT_NBR as string,
		SECURITY_ADP_NBR as string,
		Cusip as string,
		ccyCd as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource1
OLEDBSource sort(asc(adp, false)) ~> Sort1
OLEDBSource1 sort(asc(SECURITY_ADP_NBR, false)) ~> Sort
Sort,Sort1 join(SECURITY_ADP_NBR == adp,
	joinType:'inner',
	broadcast: 'none')~> MergeJoin
MergeJoin derive(loadDate = loadDate,
		CLIENT_NBR = CLIENT_NBR,
		SECURITY_ADP_NBR = SECURITY_ADP_NBR,
		Cusip = Cusip,
		ccyCd = ccyCd,
		adp = adp,
		EffDate = EffDate,
		producttype1 = producttype1,
		Isin = Isin) ~> MergeJoin0
MergeJoin0 derive(loadDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		effDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		producttype1 as string,
		adp as string,
		Isin as string,
		loadDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		effDate = EffDate,
		producttype1,
		adp,
		Isin,
		loadDate),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
